title: イノベーション基礎
subtitle: Fundamentals of Innovations
educationalGoal: This course is designed to develop students' ability to discover and solve problems by consolidating the knowledge and skills they have acquired so far, with the creation of value in the real world in mind, leading to innovation. The basic process consists of organizing needs that exist in the real world, finding solutions, and comparing and evaluating cost-effectiveness and alternative solutions.
advice: In this course, students will work systematically in teams to solve real-world problems by integrating them individually or in teams from necessary knowledge, previous experience, and a lot of information. The flow of the process varies depending on the main theme, but basically, team activities proceed in the order of “issue discovery → understanding the current situation (proving the existence of the issue, proving the existence of the need to solve the issue (needs), and understanding existing measures) → determining the issue based on analysis of the cause and structure of the issue → setting preconditions and conditions for achievement toward solution → determining a solution plan”.
books: [Reference book] Curtis R. Carlson and William W. Willmott, Five Principles of Innovation, Diamond (2012).
requiredKnowledge: Content acquired through various courses taken by the time of the course. In particular, the concept of innovation with an awareness of quality, cost, delivery, and safety in the real world in the basic training course “Engineers and Sustainable Society.

activityGoals.body: Can make logical evaluations and decisions based on realistic data and facts.
Can gather information necessary to further discussions in team activities (work).
Able to aggregate individual knowledge and apply it to value-based problem solving.
Can recognize issues that exist in the real world with diverse solutions and creatively find solutions.
To be able to efficiently carry out effective team activities (work) in a team (organization).
Demonstrate a willingness to evaluate one's own abilities objectively.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Able to add value that leads to innovation and make proposals based on that value. ・The ability to make logical evaluations and judgments based on data and facts of individual and team research, and to communicate them to third parties in a straightforward manner. ・Able to aggregate individual knowledge and information and use it to solve problems. ・Be able to recognize issues that exist in the real world, where solutions are diverse, and find solutions with a focus on value creation. ・Can lead a team (organization) in efficient and effective team activities (work).
achievementLevels.standard: ・The ability to understand the value of innovation and to make proposals based on that understanding. ・Be able to make logical evaluations and judgments based on data and facts of individual and team research, and communicate them to a third party. ・Able to aggregate individual information and use it to solve problems. ・To be able to recognize issues that exist in the real world, where solutions are diverse, and to understand solutions that focus on value creation. ・To be able to work effectively and efficiently in a team (organization).
